sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: GPT-Neo - EleutherAI
sources.snippet: GPT-Neo A series of large language models trained on the Pile. It was our first attempt to produce GPT-3-like language models and comes in 125M, 1.3B, and 2.7B parameter variants.

sources.title: liodon-ai (Liodon AI) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Liodon AI We are a research-driven open-source organization dedicated to advancing the frontier of Small Language Models (SLMs) and high-efficiency deep learning infrastructure. Our goal is to democratize highly capable, compact intelligence that can run seamlessly on resource-constrained environments and edge devices without sacrificing reasoning ability.

sources.title: GPT-Neo 125M: Lightweight Open-Source LLM for Text Generation | MIT ...
sources.snippet: GPT-Neo 125M is a 150M-parameter open-source language model trained by EleutherAI on the Pile dataset. It replicates the GPT-3 architecture at a much smaller scale, making it suitable for text generation tasks on modest hardware.

sources.title: gpt-neo-125m — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: gpt-neo-125m is distributed under the mit license. Commercial use depends on specific license terms — always verify the HuggingFace model card before production deployment.
